voice.subtitle: For six thousand years llamas stood on hills and looked unimpressed. Humans took this for attitude. It was attitude. voice.subtitle: Sir Reginald the Third of Hoofelton. First Chair of the World. There was no first or second. He chairs every meeting by standing in the room until it reaches the right answer.
